Auth failures map to typed SyncAuthFailedException with loud 'run az login' / 'run aws configure | aws sso login' hints; probe-verified SDK facts pinned in tests: no-login throws CredentialUnavailableException (not AuthenticationFailedException), AWS v4 chain resolves lazily (AmazonClientException on first call), AmazonS3Exception/AmazonClientException are siblings, raw HttpRequestException now maps to SyncNetworkException (pre-existing gap). Benchmarked System.Buffers.SearchValues<string> vs HashSet on the FTS query path (BenchmarkDotNet, real 35-query corpus). Measured: SearchValues under production's OrdinalIgnoreCase REGRESSES (1.12x — its Contains is an internal HashSet; Teddy/Aho-Corasick only accelerate IndexOfAny spans); the gain is Ordinal (tokens are pre-lowercased before checks, sets are lowercase ASCII): HashSet+Ordinal 0.71x, SearchValues+Ordinal 0.60x. Replaced Reserved/Stopwords in FtsQueryNormalizer + SourcePathQuery with SearchValues.Create(Ordinal); left IndexableExtensions as HashSet OIC (input not normalized; SearchValues slower there). 2 new casing-contract tests pin the pre-lowercasing precondition. Full suite green (471 passed/43 skipped). Findings: docs/work/2026-08-04-searchvalues-vs-hashset.md; benchmark kept in benchmarks/AiRaccoon.Benchmarks. Merged to main.

stillTrue: dotnet_env=local must be set per-directory for the DeployToLocalSource build target to push to .nupkg-local
MCP_TRANSPORT=http selects the Streamable HTTP transport at /mcp; anything else runs stdio
sqlite-memory's content-hash dedup is global — cross-context duplicates need preserve_duplicate_paths=1 + distinct logical paths
Dapper 2.1.79 parameter binding is case-sensitive against SQL param names and its record ctor matching chokes on nullable params — alias columns and use a settable DTO
sqlite-memory/vector/sync are native SQLite extensions loaded via Microsoft.Data.Sqlite LoadExtension; deferred embeddings (defer_embeddings=1) let writes work before any model is configured
The E2E server boot requires AIRACCOON_DATA_ROOT + MCP_TRANSPORT env set BEFORE host build; E2E tests mutate env so they run in a serial collection
MCP protocol CallToolResult.IsError is null on success (absent), true only on failure — assert ShouldNotBe(true), not ShouldBe(false)
